item_id.description: Store-assigned, monotonic per file, never reused.

rules.description: The rules the item bears on (a requirement id, a specification anchor, a convention of the epic's spec.md).

ref.description: The plan_id of the landing, the message_id of the plan's message; null for an observation of the epic's task.

state.description: open: not decided yet; kept: kept in its register; dropped; promoted: became a staged row (promoted_to).

trigger.description: watches only (required then): what makes the epic check the watch again; null for a finding.

kind.description: landing: a landing of the epic (of plan_id when set); base_advanced: an advance of the default branch (touching one of paths when set).

promoted_to.description: promoted only: the plan_id of the row the item became.
